name: Broken Hill Mines Limited
summary: Broken Hill Mines Limited is an Australian company primarily involved in the exploration and extraction of mineral resources. Its core focus lies in identifying and developing deposits containing silver, lead, and zinc. The firm wholly owns the Rasp Mine and the Pinnacles Mine, both strategically located in Broken Hill, New South Wales. Originally established in 2021, the company was known as Coolabah Metals Limited before officially rebranding to Broken Hill Mines Limited in July 2025. Its operational base is situated in Perth, Australia.
